description: This file defines the BomComponent class, which represents a BOM component with a reference identifier and provides methods to access and represent this reference.

classes.name: BomComponent
classes.description: A class representing a BOM component identified by a reference string. It includes methods to retrieve the reference and to generate its string representation.

methods.name: BomComponent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the component with a reference string.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the reference string associated with the BOM component.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the component, which is its reference.
